简介: Maria Muller is a Romanian film and theater actress, writer, and producer. She is also the Co-Founding Artistic Director of Et Alia, a theater company based in New York. She wrote, produced, and starred in "Where Are You from Again?" directed by Benjamin Freemantle. Other notable works include "No Tomorrow" (2024), "Queen Marie of Romania" (2019), "Love in NY" (2018), and "Smoking" (2017). She is a graduate of New York University's Tisch School of the Arts.
